test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 24 Jan 2023 Shift 2)

question: Whom has Samir Venkatapathy Kamat replaced as the new Chairman of Defence Research and Development Organisation in August 2022??
solution:
The correct answer is __**G Satheesh Reddy.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Samir Venkatapathy Kamat** has replaced **G Satheesh Reddy** as the new Chairman of **Defence Research and Development Organisation** (DRDO) in **August 2022.**
 
• G Satheesh Reddy was the **previous Chairman** of DRDO who served in this position from **2018 to 2022.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bhujanga Rao** is a **retired Indian Army officer** who served as the Director General of Ordnance Factories (**DGOF)** and **Chairman** of the Ordnance Factory Board (**OFB**).
 
• **Lalit Kumar** is** not associated** with DRDO or any other defence organization. 
 
• **Rajwant Singh** is also** not associated** with DRDO or any other defence organization.
 
• Hence, the** correct** option is 4) G Satheesh Reddy.
